note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved; ZInQ.AlphaPower.AlphaEqns a definition: AlphaEqns (also AlphaFormula) is the formula (C.2); the gadget lemmas state the replacements of <, | and congruence by equations with fresh witnesses, including the zero-modulus case, and alpha_spec that the compiled macro means the formula. The lemmas are proved without assumed hypotheses.

def AlphaEqns (X b N : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ r s t u v w x y : ℕ, 3 < b ∧ u ^ 2 + t ^ 2 = 1 + b * u * t ∧
    s ^ 2 + r ^ 2 = 1 + b * s * r ∧ r < s ∧ u ^ 2 ∣ s ∧ v + 2 * r = b * s ∧
    w % v = b % v ∧ w % u = 2 % u ∧ 2 < w ∧ x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = 1 + w * x * y ∧
    2 * X < u ∧ 2 * X < v ∧ x % v = X % v ∧ 2 * N < u ∧ x % u = N % u
